svg.aria-label: BetFi architecture: the app, the desk's modules around its event bus, pascal-mock and Pascal, and the Solana programs, with the bet lifecycle numbered

g.text: event bus · PendingOpened · HedgeFilled · TicketMinted · LegResolved · RefundNeeded · …

svg.text: full Rust stack: Dioxus app · tokio/axum desk · Anchor programs
① quote priced on Pascal's books, signed
② user signs open_pending, the sponsor co-signs
③ indexer sees the escrow: writes it, publishes it
④ hedge desk buys every leg on Pascal
⑤ crank sends finalize: the ticket is minted
⑥ Pascal's result: resolve_leg, then settle
